text:
Maya: opened a docs PR touching Private installer networking and KMS/HSM sections — PR #4207. coordinating UX nits + a single-NIC HSM edgecase.

Ashley: quick skim, looks fine. what edgecase did you see?

Maya: some single-NIC HSM hosts hit NAT rewrite issues. our current quickstart has a generic postrouting rule that rewrites mgmt traffic to the public IP and breaks HSM management connectivity on certain cloud images.

Sam: can you paste the minimal repro rule so we can add a clear callout?

Maya: repro example:
iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o eth0 -j SNAT --to-source $PUBLIC_IP
This SNAT rewrites local mgmt connections coming from containerized agents; workaround options: scope the rule with --source, use MASQUERADE for ephemeral IPs, or add explicit accept rules for management ports.

Liam: we should include both iptables and nftables examples and an HSM firewall snippet in the KMS troubleshooting section: "If running HSM on single-NIC hosts, exclude mgmt IPs/ports from SNAT."

Ashley: agree. i'll add a short bullet to the installer checklist. prefer concrete commands and code font for ports (e.g., `8700`) so users can copy/paste.

Maya: plan: (1) fix a broken anchor/crosslink I found, (2) add nftables + iptables snippets with explicit SNAT exceptions, (3) add a migration note for Dedicated -> single-NIC. i'll push shortly.

docs-bot: linkchecker: detected broken crosslink to private/onprem/kms (404) in PR. please fix before merge. :robot_face:

Sam: which anchor changed? i can patch the crosslink.

Maya: "Key management" anchor moved after a refactor; updated the target but missed the installer page link. pushing a follow-up commit in ~20m.

Liam: add this connmark/nft example to accept mgmt ports prior to SNAT, e.g.:
nft add rule nat postrouting tcp dport {8700,8743} counter accept
Short, actionable.

Maya: added that exact line in the KMS troubleshooting subsection and included an iptables scoping example too.

Ashley: LGTM on the changes i saw; i suppressed a lint warning for the generated port table.

docs-bot: CI: docs lint passed; linkcheck queued. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Sam: i'll do a final pass after your commits and merge once linkcheck clears. thanks!
